description: This file defines the BrowseFragment class, which extends Android's BrowseSupportFragment to create a TV browsing interface. It initializes a ViewModel for ratings, sets up UI components, loads media item rows, and handles item click navigation. It includes a MediaCardPresenter class responsible for creating and binding media item cards with images and ratings display.

classes.name: BrowseFragment
classes.description: A fragment that provides a TV browsing interface with rows of media content, handling UI setup, data loading, and navigation on item clicks.

classes.name: MediaCardPresenter
classes.description: A presenter class responsible for creating and binding media item cards with images from URLs and displaying rating info.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI and loads media rows when fragment activity is created.

methods.name: setupUi
methods.description: Configures the visual aspects of the browsing UI, such as title, header state, and adapter.

methods.name: loadRows
methods.description: Loads and populates the media content rows with placeholder data.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates view holder for media card views.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds media item data to the media card view, including image and rating display.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Clears image resources when the view holder is unbound.
